lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots are arranged in approximately five discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a higher density of smaller, randomly distributed spots anterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal alignment of the primary lateral spots, creating a localized grid-like node structure on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance superior edges to shadowed inferior edges.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin shows a high density of high-luminance spots. Multiple commensal fish are visible in the sub-pectoral and ventral regions.
